title: Your Village
blurb: People move in, work with what you bring home, and the home grows.

steps.text: Build a second bedroom, Snug or better.
steps.hint: A spare bed is how someone knows there is room.

steps.text: Welcome the first person who moves in.
steps.hint: Someone you know arrives when a spare bedroom stands and their trade has a room.
Ilse wants a Greenhouse, Hettie a field or a pen, a miner a Mine head.

steps.text: Reach tier II: four rooms with a Fine one, and a field or a pen.
steps.hint: It needs D-rank. The upgrade is on the Your Hearth screen.

steps.text: Reach tier III: a Grand room.
Build a Mine head: a hatch over 16 or more blocks of climbable shaft.
steps.hint: Each evening the ore of its depth comes up.

steps.text: Reach tier IV: a bell tower and four people.
steps.hint: Your village is named on the Atlas.

steps.text: Reach tier V: eight people with the old ranks and materials.
